verdict.rationale: Ironclad's developer docs provide a documented Workflows API for launching/populating contract workflows (including template IDs and bulk launch), Records API, OAuth2 authentication, and webhook support for event-driven automation, covering the full generate-populate-send lifecycle programmatically. missing for 10: no publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probe), and no independent developer hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
